description: This file provides utility functions related to opening files with specific flags, including handling interrupted system calls and setting CLOEXEC flag. It is part of a larger codebase that manages file opening operations with enhanced robustness and compatibility.

methods.name: int git_open_with_retry(const char * path,int flags,...)
methods.description: Opens a file with the specified flags, retrying if the call is interrupted by a signal (EINTR).

methods.name: int git_open_cloexec(const char * name,int flags)
methods.description: Opens a file with the CLOEXEC flag set, retrying with a fallback if not supported.
